objective: Verify benign signal fixture before board testing
setup: Vehicle disconnected; each simulated source through 10 kohm; each simulated load 100 kohm; independent current-limited board and coil supplies
stimulus: Measure resistor values and inject each bounded signal fault before connecting the board
measurements: Signal source and fault currents; source/load voltages; absence of live vehicle connection
pass_criterion: Every simulated signal source including fault injection remains at or below 1 mA; resistor dividers accounted for in expected measurements; this limit does not apply to normal coil current
required_limits: Bench fixture limits only; actual vehicle currents remain unmeasured requirements

setup: Board installed; all board rails off; disconnected simulated endpoints; dry-circuit resistance method per relay supplier
stimulus: Probe every K3-K8 COM/NC/NO
measurements: Four-wire contact resistance; alternate-path leakage; complete net map
pass_criterion: All six COMs connect only to their documented NC sources; resistance and leakage meet supplier limits and measured path error budget
required_limits: Relay dry-circuit method; Endpoint source/load impedance; allowable error E_i

setup: Correct current-limited coil supply after verifying fitted relay suffix and voltage
stimulus: Toggle common K3-K6 request then K7 then K8
measurements: All contact positions; coil currents; unintended transfers
pass_criterion: RLY1/RLY2 switch K3-K6 together in settled states; RLY3 switches only K7; RLY4 switches only K8
required_limits: Exact retained PCB mapping; coil rating and driver polarity

setup: Distinguishable simulated source voltages; each source current limited
stimulus: All eight settled combinations of the three command domains
measurements: Every COM voltage; current in every source; source-to-source continuity
pass_criterion: Each COM selects exactly its expected source; no connection between different source nets
required_limits: Simulated voltage/current limits below all component ratings

setup: Actual relay/driver/clamp assembly; simulated source/load impedance corners; simultaneous scope acquisition
stimulus: Engage and release each domain
measurements: NO-open and NC-close times; bounce; pole skew; all COM waveforms
pass_criterion: Measured static errors and transfer waveforms satisfy established endpoint correlation and diagnostic limits
required_limits: E_i; pair region C_pair; diagnostic windows T_diag_i; fault-response limit T_fault

setup: Actuated contacts; actual DAC and coil rails; current-limited endpoint simulators
stimulus: Remove board input power rapidly at minimum/mid/maximum allowed commands
measurements: DAC rail; coil current; contact state; all COM waveforms
pass_criterion: Healthy contacts eventually restore exact NC mapping and preceding dead-DAC/open intervals satisfy established endpoint requirements
required_limits: Measured DAC decay; clamp-dependent release plus bounce; T_diag_i; T_fault

setup: Programmable supply; all requests asserted; arm latch already set
stimulus: Slow ramp and short dips around PG and relay dropout thresholds
measurements: PG signals; ARM latch; coil currents; chatter; COM correlation
pass_criterion: Any invalid permit clears ARM; no reengagement upon recovery without new deliberate arm edge; transition meets limits
required_limits: Supervisor threshold/tolerance/hysteresis; supply slew envelope; T_fault

setup: Coil and DAC rails remain powered; supervisor wired as proposed
stimulus: Remove 3.3 V or force PG3 invalid
measurements: ARM latch; gate voltage; coil current; contact release time
pass_criterion: Hardware disarms without MCU service and returns defined settled connections within validated timing budget
required_limits: PG3 behavior under partial power; T_detect plus T_cut plus T_release plus T_bounce

objective: Check DAC rail or readiness loss
setup: MCU 3.3 V remains healthy; outputs selected; actual 3.3 V LVC permit driver fitted
stimulus: Remove DAC power or deassert READY; hold 5 V supply at 4.0-4.5 V with healthy 3.3 V; apply fast 5 V collapses
measurements: READY; PG5/QUALIFIED/ARM; permission gate; coil currents; selected dead-DAC interval; COM waveforms
pass_criterion: Fault inhibits through independent cutoff and healthy contacts settle NC; permission gate stays inhibited through the 4.0-4.5 V region and fast collapses; no indefinite dead-DAC selection; timing satisfies validated endpoint requirements
required_limits: READY contract; DAC decay; PG5 threshold/propagation; actual LVC driver supply and gate behavior; valid sensor correlation; T_fault

setup: MCU and upstream DAC rails remain valid; PG5 senses returned carrier 5V_RAW after manual enable and before high-side cutoff
stimulus: Remove carrier 5V_RAW with requests asserted; separately interrupt a downstream coil branch while feedback stays valid
measurements: Carrier feedback; PG5 SENSE/HEALTH_N; ARM/HB latches; residual coil current; NC restoration
pass_criterion: Loss at the returned carrier feed clears ARM/HB qualification and healthy contacts restore defaults within measured timing budget; downstream branch loss/reconnection is separately characterized without assuming it trips PG5
required_limits: Exact PG5 tap location; actual clamp release behavior; dropout current; T_fault; downstream branch fault detection coverage

setup: Independent current-limited USB/external/5 V/3.3 V supplies; actual 3.3 V LVC permit driver and 82 kohm permission biases fitted; no ECU attached
stimulus: Power each rail first/last; connect/disconnect USB with external supply absent/present; keep 3.3 V healthy while 5 V dwells at 4.0-4.5 V and collapses rapidly; test converse rail loss
measurements: Injection current into each rail; rail voltages; permission/request gate levels; coil current; GPIO levels
pass_criterion: No phantom engagement or unintended coil hold; permission remains inhibited during invalid carrier supply including 4.0-4.5 V dwell and collapse; pin/supply limits maintained throughout sequence
required_limits: Exact ESP32 board reverse-current paths; LVC partial-power specifications; combined 82 kohm load/leakage bias; PG5 threshold/delay; backfeed budget

objective: Check live source with board unpowered
setup: All board rails off; simulated endpoint source/reference nets energized within defined envelope
stimulus: Sweep every source voltage and allowed diagnostic load
measurements: Source loading; rail injection currents; voltages at unpowered IC pins; coil state
pass_criterion: No rail backfeed capable of engagement; Endpoint default-path error and every part limit satisfied
required_limits: Per-path E_i; source impedances; unpowered-pin ratings; coil pickup current

setup: Board off; USB/UART/CAN and control connectors attached to energized test equipment
stimulus: Exercise external logic levels and communication activity
measurements: Injected rail current; gate and watchdog levels; coil current
pass_criterion: External interfaces cannot phantom-power actuation; all partial-power limits satisfied
required_limits: Interface-specific off-state ratings and isolation/reverse-current paths

setup: Isolated instruments; distinct controller and simulated endpoint reference connections; current limited
stimulus: Open controller common-ground conductor without opening endpoint signal references
measurements: Reference offsets; all return currents; gate/coil levels; COM waveforms
pass_criterion: Defined disarm/default behavior; no hidden actuation return through signal/USB/CAN or measuring equipment
required_limits: Ground-offset envelope; component limits; specified response to reference loss

setup: Simulated redundant channels with independent reference conductors
stimulus: Open each reference/ground conductor separately
measurements: COM voltages; cross-channel and clamp currents; readiness response
pass_criterion: No alternate return fabricates valid channels; diagnosed fault receives defined response
required_limits: Actual sensor reference topology; C_pair; diagnostic rules

setup: Carrier contact board remains installed in signal harness; identify complete supervisor J1 controller bundle separately from carrier JCTRL/J5 bundle and individual wires
stimulus: Remove and reinstall complete controller J1 bundle in every active request state
measurements: READY/WDI; PG3/HEALTH_N; coil current; ARM/HB latches; NC mapping after release; state on reinsertion
pass_criterion: Lost READY/WDI/logic rail inhibits as designed; healthy contacts restore default connections; complete controller bundle reinsertion does not automatically arm; this result does not establish individual-wire supervision
required_limits: Connector pin order/hot-plug envelope; rail supervisor reset behavior; exact bundle identity

objective: Check entire inline board removal honestly
setup: Simulated harness endpoints; removable complete relay adapter; verified separate bypass plug available
stimulus: Remove complete adapter then install bypass plug
measurements: Through-path continuity before/after removal and after plug insertion
pass_criterion: Removal without retained bypass is recorded as disconnected; verified replacement plug alone restores the retained NC contact mapping; its vehicle-safe meaning remains unverified
required_limits: Mechanical connector identity; bypass-plug pin map; no parallel plug/active-board connection

setup: All permits valid; deliberately armed; ARM button held
stimulus: Invalidate each permit briefly then restore it while ARM remains held; supply zero/one/two fresh falling WDI edges; test with each request high
measurements: ARM/HB_ONE/HB_GOOD DFF states; coil gate; all contacts; response to subsequent release/new press
pass_criterion: Any inhibit clears all three latches; held ARM never rearms; rearm needs two post-READY falling WDI edges plus a new ARM edge with all request nets low
required_limits: DFF reset dominance; reset pulse minimum; ARM debounce; setup/hold under recovery; ZERO_REQ logic

objective: Keep watchdog distinct from valid commands
setup: Qualified READY initially false; watchdog test generator provides nominal heartbeat
stimulus: Nominal heartbeat with uncalibrated DAC/stale/implausible command; early/late/stopped heartbeat with READY true
measurements: READY contract; watchdog result; ARM latch; cutoff latency
pass_criterion: Nominal heartbeat alone cannot authorize actuation; early/late/stopped heartbeat clears ARM independently
required_limits: Watchdog window tolerance; command freshness/plausibility qualification implemented elsewhere

objective: Check frozen controller and stuck request
setup: Hardware supervisor functional; selected outputs active
stimulus: Freeze MCU; hold request GPIO high/low; suppress command refresh
measurements: Watchdog and READY response; gate; coil release; COM waveforms
pass_criterion: Defined timeout/inhibit cuts drive independently of frozen code; no automatic rearm
required_limits: Watchdog bounds; command freshness contract; T_fault

setup: Safe fixture emulates one transistor fault at a time; all supplies current limited
stimulus: Short high-side cutoff or one low-side driver individually; then inhibit permits
measurements: Residual coil current; contact state; independent cutoff response
pass_criterion: Healthy manual feed contact removes coil power even with a failed-on high-side gate; automatic-inhibit defeat while enable is held is recorded as a single-fault vulnerability
required_limits: Actual cutoff topology; fault current; FMEA safety claim

objective: Check stuck contacts and broken bypass trace
setup: Fixture connections emulate contact faults without deliberately welding relays
stimulus: For each pole emulate STUCK_NO/STUCK_OPEN/STUCK_BOTH/STUCK_NC and NC trace open
measurements: Connected source sets; COM values; diagnostics and inhibition
pass_criterion: Ordinary Form-C single-contact faults are exposed honestly; no claim that coil power removal repairs NO weld or NC open
required_limits: Contact-fault detection coverage; required single-fault scope; endpoint fault behavior

objective: Check K7/K8 mixed states and timing skew
setup: Exact J4-8/J4-9 endpoint simulator identified; independently monitored K7/K8
stimulus: All four command states; delayed pole release; one stuck pole
measurements: J4-18/J4-19 values; differential voltage; currents; mechanical transfer timing
pass_criterion: 00/11 and both same-source half-states have documented tolerated response; otherwise the endpoint switching architecture is rejected
required_limits: Actual endpoint function; load current; inductance; required endpoint/default behavior; brake/coast only if a motor endpoint is established

setup: No vehicle hardware; voltage/current-limited fault generator; protection network fitted
stimulus: Short each signal to ground/adjacent source or specified fault rail
measurements: Fault current; temperature; damage; cross-channel drive; recovery
pass_criterion: All parts/protection remain within specified fault limits and defined response occurs without unsafe propagation
required_limits: Actual short-to-ground/battery envelope; protection energy; part ratings; T_fault

setup: Chamber and environmental fixtures only after basic electrical tests pass
stimulus: Project temperature/humidity/vibration and load impedance extremes
measurements: Contact resistance/leakage; coil pickup/dropout; release/bounce/skew; COM errors
pass_criterion: Previously established electrical and timing limits hold over project envelope
required_limits: Project environmental envelope; relay environmental qualifications; E_i; T_fault

setup: Actual minimum-energy signal loads and maximum allowed loads; protected cycling fixture
stimulus: Cycle to defined mission-life target and periodically characterize
measurements: Missed transfers; contact resistance drift; stuck/welded contacts; bounce evolution
pass_criterion: Supplier load/life assumptions and project life target met; empty-load cycles alone do not establish loaded lifetime
required_limits: Minimum switching-load guidance; contact material; mission cycles; environmental aging

objective: Check suppression failure and coil decay
setup: Actual clamp/diode/driver with current-limited coil supply; fixture fault substitutes
stimulus: Compare fitted clamp decay; emulate open or short suppression as bounded by protection design
measurements: Coil current decay; driver drain voltage; release/bounce; damage/cutoff behavior
pass_criterion: Release budget and transistor/clamp limits hold; suppression failure vulnerability recorded rather than assumed away
required_limits: Coil inductance/energy; diode/TVS clamp ratings; MOSFET VDS; T_fault

setup: Vehicle disconnected; identified ECU/sensor/actuator simulator or controlled HIL
stimulus: Replay measured dead-DAC/open/bounce/skew and command-fault cases
measurements: DTCs; channel plausibility; modeled actuator request/response; fault recovery
pass_criterion: Exact endpoint diagnostic and fault-response requirements pass before any vehicle actuation decision
required_limits: Exact model/year/endpoint requirements; official wiring and diagnostic evidence

setup: Completed physical reports; raw scope traces; part revision and connector identity recorded
stimulus: Compare all failures and remaining assumptions with intended safety claim
measurements: Requirement coverage; outstanding failures; relay/current/environment qualification
pass_criterion: Claim remains limited to demonstrated behavior; missing wiring/electrical/HIL gates block vehicle release
required_limits: Independent review; exact vehicle identity; complete measurement contract

objective: Check heartbeat pipeline reset and timing
setup: Actual 74LVC74 qualification stages and watchdog connected; READY is an external assertion whose meaning is separately verified
stimulus: Hold READY low while clocking; release READY; supply two falling WDI edges; apply trips near WDI/ARM transitions
measurements: HB_ONE/HB_GOOD/ARM; reset/clock pin waveforms; short gate pulses
pass_criterion: Pre-READY edges cannot qualify; first post-READY edge sets HB_ONE only; second can set HB_GOOD; every trip clears all stages and no unqualified ARM pulse reaches coil gates
required_limits: 74LVC74 reset dominance and recovery/setup/hold requirements; watchdog window and actual edge polarities

setup: Actual carrier request drivers with 330 ohm series gate resistors and 10 kohm pulldowns; qualified 3.3 V request drive at allowed rail/temperature corners; permission gate has separate 82 kohm bias tests
stimulus: Apply each request HIGH/LOW and disconnected cable; repeat with maximum allowed cable/connector resistance
measurements: Request header voltage; request MOSFET gate voltage; coil voltage/current; relay pickup and release
pass_criterion: Request header HIGH is at least 2.60 V and measured request MOSFET gate is at least 2.50 V; actual drive and coil switching meet datasheet limits using RDS(on) characterized at 2.5 V; LOW/disconnect cuts drive within measured timing budget
required_limits: Request-only header criterion 2.60 V; request-gate criterion 2.50 V; derived request divider minimum 2.517 V before additional cable/connector loss; exact MOSFET 2.5 V RDS(on) rating; GPIO VOH/VOL; coil rating and rail envelope

objective: Check complete carrier power/control bundle removal and return
setup: Carrier signal contacts remain in harness; carrier JCTRL pin 6 returns actual 5V_RAW to supervisor J5 pin 7/R22; feedback is after physical enable and before high-side cutoff
stimulus: Disconnect complete carrier JCTRL/J5 power-control bundle while armed; reconnect with ARM held and requests asserted; then qualify fresh WDI edges and deliberate zero-request ARM edge
measurements: Carrier 5V_RAW; CARRIER_5V_FEEDBACK; PG5 SENSE/HEALTH_N; ARM/HB_ONE/HB_GOOD; coil current; settled NC mapping
pass_criterion: Bundle loss drops returned feedback and asynchronously clears qualification/ARM through PG5 within measured detection limits; reconnecting cannot itself rearm; only fresh heartbeat qualification and a deliberate zero-request ARM edge restore permission
required_limits: Feedback pin continuity; exact PG5 threshold/tolerance/reset delay; manual-feed and high-side tap locations; T_fault; no backfeed that holds feedback falsely valid

objective: Expose individual request or permit wire reconnect limitation
setup: Whole carrier bundle and returned 5V_RAW remain connected and valid; ARM latched; isolate one conductor with a safe break fixture
stimulus: Open/reconnect each REQ_L/REQ_7/REQ_8 or COIL_PERMIT wire individually with its logical request asserted; repeat separately with a downstream coil branch
measurements: PG5 validity; ARM/HB latches; request/permit gate levels; coil current and contact state before/after reconnection
pass_criterion: Record whether output resumes without a fresh ARM edge while power feedback remains valid; do not claim whole-bundle feedback supervises every wire or guarantees rearm after individual-wire faults; unresolved unsafe reconnect behavior blocks expanded safety claims
required_limits: Specific conductor default bias; actual endpoint risk; individual-wire detection coverage; whole-bundle versus partial-disconnect distinction

objective: Measure permission-gate bias and partial-power behavior
setup: Supervisor U13 is 3.3 V LVC1G08; SUP R18 is 1 kohm; carrier RG6 is 330 ohm; SUP R19 and carrier RPD6 are each 82 kohm; fit actual MOSFET and cable
stimulus: Exercise valid permit and every inhibit; detach supervisor output; remove 3.3 V while carrier 5 V remains; hold 5 V at 4.0-4.5 V with healthy 3.3 V; apply fast collapses; sweep allowable leakage/load and temperature
measurements: U13 supply/output voltage; COIL_PERMIT header and MOSFET gate; output load/leakage current; PG5/QUALIFIED; switched coil voltage and coil current
pass_criterion: Enabled drive meets MOSFET characterized drive/RDS(on) and coil limits under combined divider/loading; every inhibit or partial-power case holds gate and coil current below verified pickup/hold conditions and returns healthy contacts to defaults within measured timing budget
required_limits: Actual LVC VOH/VOL and Ioff limits; combined two-82 kohm network and series resistors; MOSFET leakage/drive rating; cable load; PG5 threshold/delay; release/bounce; request-driver 10 kohm test is separate
